page.overview:
What is Cedrella Black?

Cedrella Weasley (née Black) was a pure-blood witch and a member of the noble House of Black. She was the second daughter of Arcturus Black (II) and Lysandra Yaxley, and the middle sister of Callidora and Charis.

Cedrella married Septimus Weasley. The Weasley family had been considered blood traitors ever since they protested their inclusion in the Sacred Twenty-Eight, and so, due to her marriage, Cedrella was disowned and blasted off the Black family tree tapestry.

Cedrella and Septimus had three sons, one of whom is Arthur Weasley. Through Cedrella, the Weasley family is related not only to the House of Black, but also to the Crouch and Longbottom families. Through Arthur, she has seven grandchildren.

Cedrella is a rare feminine variant of "Cedric", which in turn is derived from the Old Celtic name Caratacos, which means "love". This could be a reference to her betraying her family's beliefs to marry who she loved.
